notes: Group: Imperial Senate (DARK SIDE). FULL portrait site overlay printed sideways that RENAMES the site: both bars read '•CORUSCANT: CHANCELLOR’S OFFICE' (curly apostrophe; red • on the Dark bar, dark • on the Light bar). Art window blank. Light half (right bar, grey box) = game_text, one line. Dark half (left bar, black box) = dark_text, two lines (break after 'Force drains and Force'). INLINE: ▼ then a blue sphere before 'Sidious' = the VS16 set sphere itself (matched against the sphere at the bottom of the slip; Lord Sidious (V) is VS16 #46) → {ovs}; the stub drops the sphere and expands ▼. Force slots: Dark bar TWO red sabers (dark_force_count 2), Light bar one blue saber — same as the printed card (Dark Force ×2, Light Force ×1). Icon boxes both bars, outermost first: planet (pink planet), interior (beige walls) — same as printed; no scomp. Bottom margin: the VS16 set sphere and a black EPISODE I icon → icons ['episode1'] (as vs13/03; the printed Coruscant site carries Episode I too). No credits. BASE: caption names Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room (Dark) (Coruscant Dark site; printed Light 'Unless Amidala present, Force drain -1 here.', Dark 'If Haako or Gunray present, Force drain +1 here.').
